subsystems.name: Brain mapping system
subsystems.role: capture the complete wiring diagram and ongoing activity of a brain at synaptic resolution.

subsystems.name: Neural data processing
subsystems.role: store, reconstruct and analyse the enormous dataset produced by brain mapping.

subsystems.name: Brain simulation platform
subsystems.role: emulate the brain's neurons, synapses and dynamics in software.

subsystems.name: Neural interface
subsystems.role: read and write neural signals to capture a living brain's state or connect a mind to a simulation.

subsystems.name: Consciousness validation and digital environment
subsystems.role: verify that a simulated mind is conscious and provide it with a virtual world.

buildSteps.title: Map a complete brain at synaptic resolution
buildSteps.detail: Use destructive electron microscopy to trace every neuron and synapse in a small mammal or insect brain, building a full connectome.

buildSteps.title: Develop non-destructive scanning
buildSteps.detail: Invent a method to read a living human brain's connectome and activity without damaging tissue, perhaps using advanced nanoscale probes or quantum sensors.

buildSteps.title: Build a computational model
buildSteps.detail: Translate the connectome into a software model with realistic neuron and synapse dynamics, starting with small circuits.

buildSteps.title: Simulate a whole brain in real time
buildSteps.detail: Run the model on an exascale computer or specialised neuromorphic hardware fast enough to match biological timescales.

buildSteps.title: Create a high-bandwidth neural interface
buildSteps.detail: Develop a two-way link that can read and write millions of neurons simultaneously, far beyond today's hundred-channel implants.

buildSteps.title: Transfer the brain state
buildSteps.detail: Capture a living brain's moment-to-moment activity and align it with the simulation so the digital mind continues seamlessly.

buildSteps.title: Validate consciousness
buildSteps.detail: Test whether the simulation behaves like the original person and reports subjective experiences, using rigorous protocols.

buildSteps.title: Provide a digital environment
buildSteps.detail: Build a virtual world with sensory inputs and outputs that the uploaded mind can inhabit and interact with.

prerequisites.why: complete connectomes exist for small organisms like the fruit fly, but not for mammals or humans.
no method can read a living human brain's synapses without damaging it.
current supercomputers simulate small neural networks, not a human brain in real time.
existing implants read hundreds of neurons; a human brain has tens of billions.

prerequisites.tech: Theory of consciousness and neural correlates
prerequisites.why: we cannot yet define or measure consciousness objectively, making validation speculative.

pathway.milestone: complete connectome of a small mammal brain using destructive methods
real-time simulation of a small neural circuit that produces simple behaviours
pathway.unlocks: proof that software can replicate brain function at a basic level.

pathway.milestone: non-destructive mapping of a living mammal brain at cellular resolution
pathway.unlocks: ability to capture a living brain's state without harm.

pathway.milestone: whole-brain simulation of a human with consciousness-like properties, validated by behaviour
pathway.unlocks: candidate uploaded minds and ethical frameworks.

pathway.milestone: mind uploading for humans with digital environments
pathway.unlocks: digital afterlife or enhanced cognition, if consciousness can be verified.
